verdict.rationale: Skills run inside Claude, the built-in assistant. Users delegate tasks either by letting Claude load a relevant skill automatically or by invoking one directly with `/skill-name`. Bundled skills such as `/run` and `/verify` work without setup, and subagents and agent teams extend the ways work can be handed off. Several hands-on community reports say Claude often fails to pick up skills on its own and needs explicit triggering, though direct invocation still works. Missing for 10: reliable automatic delegation (community reports inconsistent auto-triggering), independent corroboration of end-to-end task delegation quality.
